site.name: Live Again CS
site.heroText: Every match from the first stage to the grand final. No scores, no video lengths, nothing that gives the result away.

how.title: No scores
how.text: Results never show up in titles, thumbnails or anywhere on the page.

how.title: No video lengths
how.text: Run times and progress bars stay hidden, so a long map can't tip you off.

how.title: Every map listed
how.text: Each series shows all of its possible maps, so you can't count how many were played.

how.title: Later rounds locked
how.text: Matchups that would give away earlier results stay hidden until you open them.
